author: Nintendo of America YouTube
text:
Kalanoro – Launch Trailer – Nintendo Switch
Play Kalanoro now on Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6006a9054

Hop on a colorful action-adventure inspired by Malagasy folklore! Recruit legendary lemur musicians, grow your band's fame across Lemuria, and challenge the evil witch Raneny in a quest to save the island—one song at a time! 

Once a paradise, the island of Lemuria now suffers under Raneny’s ruthless rule. Having grown tired of exploiting its people, she decided to host a huge concert with the island’s most famous band. You’re sent on a mission to fight back by rallying legendary musicians to your cause! 

Dash through diverse biomes, save and befriend funky locals to form your crew, and jump over industrial platforming traps to become Lemuria’s number one band and finally face Raneny. Defeat her minions in fast-paced combat, using hair-based powers and improvised weapons (slippers included). Fight epic and groovy boss battles, and free the island! 

#Kalanoro
